title: Format meta (meta.json)
description: Workflow data deliberately kept out of config.json per FORMAT_CONFIG_GUIDE.md: registry status, review sign-off, and (optionally) document-structure/entitlement/provenance data for formats that want it. Only formatId/phaseId/displayName/status are required — the extract-research-format skill produces exactly that minimal shape plus reviewedBy for a freshly-extracted draft; everything else is additive for formats that need richer workflow tracking (e.g. paid-tier gating).

reviewedBy.description: Flat review sign-off, as produced by the extract-research-format skill: null until a human reviewer publishes the draft. Mutually informative with (but simpler than) `provenance.reviewedBy` below — a format uses one or the other, not both.

sectionOrder.description: Optional. Section ids in the order they must appear in the output, regardless of their order in the IR.

requiredBlocks.description: Optional. Section ids or blockKinds that must be present in the IR before the document may render.

numbering.description: Optional. External content numbering (e.g. CONSORT item '4a'/'4b'), read verbatim from the IR — distinct from headingNumbering in config.json, which is about automatic Word heading numbers.

provenance.description: Optional, richer alternative to the flat `reviewedBy` field above — used by formats that track full authorship/extraction provenance.
